description: This file provides utility functions for creating writable streams for file downloads, handling service worker communication, and fallback mechanisms for browsers lacking certain features. It includes functions for creating iframes, checking support for transferable streams, and managing download streams with service worker integration.

methods.name: makeIframe
methods.description: Creates a hidden iframe element with specified source and appends it to the document body.

methods.name: checkSupportsTransferable
methods.description: Checks if the environment supports transferable streams for efficient data transfer.

methods.name: createWriteStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a writable stream for file download, utilizing service worker if available, with fallback support.
